SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Misc. File No. 507/36.
76c8
Wayside Station,
REPORT
Date 11th Novr 1936.

Subject Assistance to French Police.

Made by D.S. Wittlisky. Forwarded by ____________________

Sir,
At 2 p.m. on 11-11-36, D.S. Ivenoff attached to the French
Police Headquarters, came to this station and requested assistance
in visiting a female named Dunaevskaya, at 59 Chusan Road, in
connection with the "Mary Wendt and Al Stay" narcotic smuggling
case.

On being interviewed by the undersigned D.S. Ivenoff stated,
that information has been received by the French Police to the
effect, that about 1 month ago, a female named Liubov Dunaevskaya
25, Polish Jewess, employed as a dancing partner in the "Frisco"
Cabaret, Rue Dhu Pao Sen, F.C. by producing a post Office notice,
obtained from a sub-Post Office on Rue du Consulat a letter
addressed to Henri Le Granclaude c/o French Consul in Shanghai
and that it was suspected, that the letter may have some connect-
ion or contained information re the "Mary Wendt" smuggling case.

Henri Le Granclaude, French subject, to whom the letter was
addressed, is at present detained in the Ward Road Gaol pending
the decision of the French Consular Court where he is being
charged with being in possession of a false passport.

Assistance was rendered by the undersigned and Miss L.
Dunaevskaya interviewed at 59 Chusan Road. She stated, that
about 1 month ago whilst in the "Frisco" cabaret, she was given
by a barman, nicknamed Uncle Vania, Russian, 2 Post Office
notifications for registered letters, one of which was in her
name from a girl friend in Tsingtao and the other in the name of
a Frenchman. She obtained the letters from the sub-Post Office
on Rue du Consulat and not knowing what to do with the 2nd letter
kept it in her room.

L. Dunaevskaya readily produced the letter, the envelope of

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
杂项档案号 507/36。
76c8
路边巡捕房，
报告
日期 1936年11月11日。

事由：协助法国警察。

呈报人：警探 D.S. Wittlisky。转呈人：___

先生，
1936年11月11日下午2时，配属至法国警察总部的警探 Ivenoff 来到本巡捕房，请求协助前往中山路59号拜访一名名为 Dunaevskaya 的女子，此事与“Mary Wendt 和 Al Stay”毒品走私案有关。

经卑职问询，警探 Ivenoff 称，法国警方收到情报，内容如下：约一个月前，一名名为 Liubov Dunaevskaya、25岁、波兰籍犹太女子，在法租界宝森路（Rue Dhu Pao Sen）的“Frisco”舞厅担任舞伴，她出示一张邮局通知单，从领事馆路（Rue du Consulat）的一个邮政支局领取了一封寄给 Henri Le Granclaude、由上海法国领事馆转交的信函；据怀疑，该信函可能与“Mary Wendt”走私案有关联或包含相关信息。

信函收件人 Henri Le Granclaude 系法国籍人士，目前因被指控持有伪造护照，正羁押于华德路监狱，等待法国领事法庭的裁决。

卑职提供了协助，并在中山路59号对 L. Dunaevskaya 小姐进行了问话。她陈述，约一个月前在“Frisco”舞厅时，一名绰号“万尼亚大叔”（Uncle Vania）的俄罗斯籍酒吧侍者给了她两张挂号信邮局通知单，其中一张是她在青岛的一位女友寄给她的，另一张则是一位法国人的名字。她从领事馆路的邮政支局领取了信件，因不知如何处理第二封信，便将其留在自己的房间内。

L. Dunaevskaya 爽快地出示了该信函，信封上

（左侧页边批注及印章）：
Pass cutting
Guest of John
（印：特别支部 1936年11月12日 上海）
已记录
Malacari
